items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 6 at 6:45AM EDT until September 7 at 10:00PM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 10 to 20 kt and seas 4 to 6 ft expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from NC VA border to Currituck Beach
Light NC out 20 NM.

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 10 PM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
